result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. I haven't run it end to end: running the built jar needs approval in this session, so the behaviour is verified by reading the code, and the module's existing tests pass (`mvn -o -pl cli test`).

What changed:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and its description (the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`). The overview list now includes `analyzeLandscape` alongside `updateLandscape`.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to `updateLandscape(...)`, which now takes the typed command name and its description. So `analyzeLandscape -help` shows its own name and description, while `updateLandscape -help` keeps its original usage.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape" section describing both names, their shared options, and `-help`.

I did not commit. Cli `target/` was rebuilt with `mvn -o -pl cli package -DskipTests`.
